items.title: Elastic Stack 9.4.10 released
items.summary: Version 9.4.10 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 9.4.10 over the previous version 9.4.9For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.
